items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: I worked with him right towards the end. When he died, I worked right up to the time that he died. I wrote about, I guess maybe, 15, 20 tunes with him.

ctx.x: Oh, wonderful people. You just can't imagine. Wonderful people. And his wife, you know? His wife. You meet these guys, you know? And they didn't call her mama for that. She took care of everybody.
Sure. And Nick LaRocca. Nick LaRocca's another person that very few people got to know real well. Because he was sort of a little bit cantankerous and a little bit obnoxious, you know?
He tried to claim everybody. Yeah.
